scope: Save/load lot 8: original Save/Load bodies of the movers and brushes (Door, RotatingDoor, the Rotating aggregate, CDestructableBrush, CDebris, WorldModelDebris, CDestructableModel, the CDestructable aggregate block, VolumeBrush and its types, TripLaser, Tchernotronic), their PRECREATE_SAVEGAME and INITIALUPDATE_SAVEGAME branches and save-support declarations. The bodies are selective ports recorded in the provenance ledger; the checks, the RejectPayload service and the clock inverse are OpenBlood2 code.

references.purpose: Door Save/Load field order (Door.cpp:1110-1189), DTF_* trigger flags, PostPropRead on every precreate, InitialUpdate returning at once for INITIALUPDATE_SAVEGAME, the never-assigned m_bLocked/m_dwFlags and the unsaved busy-loop handle.

RotatingDoor block before Door's (RotatingDoor.cpp:473-524), short open directions written as DWords, current angles, the unconditional degree-to-radian precreate conversion and the skipped savegame InitialUpdate.

Rotating aggregate block (Rotating.cpp:685-750): self reference, velocities, spin times, relative last/start times, zero-based current angles, state and sound strings; InitialUpdate skipped on a savegame.
Aggregate addition order (CDestructableBrush's, then Rotating) and the unconditional Init on initial update.
Aggregate addition order on CDestructableModel and the unconditional Init.
CDestructableBrush block (DestructableBrush.cpp:385-424), the never-assigned debris skin, PostPropRead on every precreate and the non-savegame-only initial update.
CDebris aggregate block (Debris.cpp:462-532), material flag order, never-assigned Texture2/Model2 and constructor explosion radius/damage.
WorldModelDebris block before CDestructableBrush's (WorldModelDebris.cpp:207-235) and the non-savegame Init/SetOff.
CDestructableModel block (DestructableModel.cpp:969-1050), m_dwDestroyFlags from the three destroy booleans, m_fYaw from the Rotation property, the absolute m_fLastTime and the unsaved sliding state.
CDestructable aggregate block (Destructable.cpp:1134-1245): framing markers, self reference stored only while unbound, non-damageable health sentinel and list re-insertion.

VolumeBrush block (VolumeBrush.cpp:758-878), constructor m_dwFlags, m_vLastPos at surface creation, the Load tail recreating the surface and resetting user flags, the constructor container code reapplied at precreate and the m_hPlayerClass set only by the non-savegame initial update.
Volume subclasses add constructor constants only, no saved state.
TripLaser block (TripLaser.cpp:488-563), relative damage time, forced model/skin on every precreate and the loop restarted in Load when triggered.
Tchernotronic block (Tchernotronic.cpp:434-480), relative removal time and the unconditional property read.
